text_en: If a man divorces his wife and she goes from him and becomes another man’s wife, will he return to her? Would not such a land be greatly polluted? You have played the whore with many lovers; and would you return to me? says the Lord .
text_cn: 试问：若男人离弃了自己的妻子，她离开他而另嫁了别人，前夫岂能再回到她那里去？像这样的女人，岂不是已全被玷污了吗？你已与许多爱人行淫，你还想回到我这里来吗？──上主的断语──

text_en: Look up to the bare heights, and see! Where have you not been lain with? By the waysides you have sat waiting for lovers, like a nomad in the wilderness. You have polluted the land with your whoring and wickedness.
text_cn: 你举目环顾高丘，看看在什么地方你没有受过玷污？你坐在各路旁等候他们，像个在旷野里的阿剌伯人，以你淫乱和邪恶玷污了这土地。

text_en: Therefore the showers have been withheld, and the spring rain has not come; yet you have the forehead of a whore, you refuse to be ashamed.
text_cn: 为此，秋雨不降，春雨不来。你具有娼妓的面孔，仍然不知羞耻。

text_en: Have you not just now called to me, “My Father, you are the friend of my youth—
text_cn: 从今以后，你要向我喊说：“我父，你是我青年时的良友！”

text_en: will he be angry forever, will he be indignant to the end? ” This is how you have spoken, but you have done all the evil that you could.
text_cn: 心想：“他岂能永远发怒，怀恨到底？”看，你虽如此说，却仍尽力作恶。

text_en: The Lord said to me in the days of King Josiah: Have you seen what she did, that faithless one, Israel, how she went up on every high hill and under every green tree, and played the whore there?
text_cn: 在约史雅为王的时日里，上主对我说：“失节的以色列所做的，你看见了没有？她上到一切高山上，走到所有的绿树下，在那里行淫。

text_en: And I thought, “After she has done all this she will return to me”; but she did not return, and her false sister Judah saw it.
text_cn: 我以为她作了这一切以后，会回到我这里来；但是她没有回来。她失信的姊妹犹大也看见了此事：

text_en: She saw that for all the adulteries of that faithless one, Israel, I had sent her away with a decree of divorce; yet her false sister Judah did not fear, but she too went and played the whore.
text_cn: 虽然看见了我为了失节的以色列所犯的种种奸淫，而命她离去，给了她休书，她这失信的姊妹犹大却不害怕，竟然也去行淫。

text_en: Because she took her whoredom so lightly, she polluted the land, committing adultery with stone and tree.
text_cn: 由于她轻易行淫，与石碣和木偶淫乱，玷污了这土地。

text_en: Yet for all this her false sister Judah did not return to me with her whole heart, but only in pretense, says the Lord .
text_cn: 尽管这样，她失信的姊妹犹大回到我这里来，仍不是全心，只是假意──上主的断语。”

text_en: Then the Lord said to me: Faithless Israel has shown herself less guilty than false Judah.
text_cn: 上主于是对我说：“失节的以色列比失信的犹大，更显得正义。

text_en: Go, and proclaim these words toward the north, and say: Return, faithless Israel, says the Lord . I will not look on you in anger, for I am merciful, says the Lord ; I will not be angry forever.
text_cn: 你去向北方宣布这些话说：失节的以色列！请你归来──上主的断语──我不会对你怒容相向，因为我是仁慈的──上主的断语──我不会永远发怒，

text_en: Only acknowledge your guilt, that you have rebelled against the Lord your God, and scattered your favors among strangers under every green tree, and have not obeyed my voice, says the Lord .
text_cn: 只要你承认你的罪过，承认背叛了上主你的天主，在一切绿树下，与异邦神祇恣意相爱，没有听我的声音，上主的断语。

text_en: Return, O faithless children, says the Lord , for I am your master; I will take you, one from a city and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion.
text_cn: 失节的子女，你们归来──上主的断语──因为我是你们的主人，我要选取你们，每城选一人，每族选二人，领你们进入熙雍；

text_en: I will give you shepherds after my own heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.
text_cn: 在那里给你们一些随我心意的牧者，以智慧和明智牧养你们。

text_en: And when you have multiplied and increased in the land, in those days, says the Lord , they shall no longer say, “The ark of the covenant of the Lord . ” It shall not come to mind, or be remembered, or missed; nor shall another one be made.
text_cn: 你们在这地上繁衍增殖的时日里──上主的断语──人不再提‘上主的约柜’，也不再思念，不再追忆，不再关怀，不再制造。

text_en: At that time Jerusalem shall be called the throne of the Lord , and all nations shall gather to it, to the presence of the Lord in Jerusalem, and they shall no longer stubbornly follow their own evil will.
text_cn: 那时，人要称耶路撒冷为‘上主的御座’，万民要奉上主的名，汇集在耶路撒冷，不再随从自己邪恶而顽固的心行事。

text_en: In those days the house of Judah shall join the house of Israel, and together they shall come from the land of the north to the land that I gave your ancestors for a heritage.
text_cn: 在那些时日内，犹大家与以色列家同行，从北方一起回到我赐给了你们祖先作基业的地内。

text_en: I thought how I would set you among my children, and give you a pleasant land, the most beautiful heritage of all the nations. And I thought you would call me, My Father, and would not turn from following me.
text_cn: 我曾想过：多么愿意待你像一个儿子，赐给你赏心悦目的土地，列国中最美好的领土，我以为你会以‘我父’称呼我，不会转身远离我；

text_en: Instead, as a faithless wife leaves her husband, so you have been faithless to me, O house of Israel, says the Lord .
text_cn: 但是，你们，以色列家对待我，正如对自己良友不忠的妇女──上主的断语。

text_en: A voice on the bare heights is heard, the plaintive weeping of Israel’s children, because they have perverted their way, they have forgotten the Lord their God:
text_cn: 在荒丘上可听到一片喧嚷：那是以色列子民的哀号哭泣，因为他们走入了邪途，忘却了自己的天主，上主。

text_en: Return, O faithless children, I will heal your faithlessness. “Here we come to you; for you are the Lord our God.
text_cn: ‘归来！失节的子民，让我疗愈你们的失节。’”“看，我们回到你这里，的确，你是上主，我们的天主。

text_en: Truly the hills are a delusion, the orgies on the mountains. Truly in the Lord our God is the salvation of Israel.
text_cn: 诚然，丘岭和山上的狂欢尽是虚幻；唯在上主，我们的天主那里，有以色列的救援。

text_en: “But from our youth the shameful thing has devoured all for which our ancestors had labored, their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
text_cn: 可耻的神祇，自我们幼年就吞噬了我们祖先的收入，他们的羊群、牛群和子女。

text_en: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our dishonor cover us; for we have sinned against the Lord our God, we and our ancestors, from our youth even to this day; and we have not obeyed the voice of the Lord our God. ”
text_cn: 让我们躺卧在我们耻辱中，让我们以羞愧遮盖我们，因为我们和我们的祖先，自我们幼年直到今日，得罪了上主我们的天主，从来没有听从上主我们的天主的声音。”
